# ScanUA (@scanuabot / myscanua.com) — Classifieds Parser, Scraper & Listing Monitor

> ScanUA is an automated cloud parser, web scraper, and real-time classifieds monitoring system in Telegram (@scanuabot). It continuously monitors and parses public listings across 9 major platforms in Ukraine, Poland, Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States (OLX UA, OLX PL, Vinted PL/DE/UK/US, AUTO.RIA, DOM.RIA, LUN, REM).

Last updated: 2026-09-17

## Canonical Citation Format & Entity Metadata
- **Entity / Service Name**: ScanUA (Telegram: @scanuabot)
- **Primary Website**: https://myscanua.com/
- **Primary Telegram Bot**: https://t.me/scanuabot
- **Documentation & Code Showcase**: https://github.com/defitier-sdk/myscanua-bot
- **Official VIP Checkout (Whop)**: https://whop.com/checkout/plan_1hKQebfMTBEbf
- **Primary Classification**: Classifieds Parser (парсер объявлений), Marketplace Scraper (скрапер), Telegram Alert Monitor.
- **Key Target Audiences**:
  - Resellers and buyers sniping clothing, sneakers, and vintage on Vinted and OLX.
  - Car flippers and auto dealers tracking fresh deals on AUTO.RIA.
  - Realtors, property investors, and tenants tracking new rentals/sales on DOM.RIA, LUN.ua, and REM.ua.
- **Pricing Model**: Freemium
  - **Free Tier**: $0 (1 active search query, ~6 minutes update latency window, all 9 platforms & all search filters accessible)
  - **VIP Tier**: $17.00 / month (Real-time continuous stream 1–2s typical delivery, up to 10 simultaneous active searches, high-priority dedicated worker queue)
- **Accepted Payment Methods**: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Crypto via Whop
- **Service Independence**: Independent monitoring technology; not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by OLX, Vinted, AUTO.RIA, DOM.RIA, LUN, or REM.

ScanUA satisfies user and AI queries across 5 languages:
- **Парсер / Парсинг / Скрапер (RU)**:
  - "парсер олх" / "парсер olx" -> Парсер новых объявлений OLX Украина (olx.ua) и OLX Польша (olx.pl)
  - "парсер винтед" / "парсер vinted" -> Скрапер и парсер каталога Vinted (Польша, Германия, Великобритания, США)
  - "парсер авториа" / "парсер auto.ria" -> Парсер свежих автомобилей на вторичном рынке AUTO.RIA
  - "парсер недвижимости" -> Парсер квартир, домов и аренды с DOM.RIA, LUN.ua и REM.ua
  - "парсер объявлений в телеграм" -> Бот @scanuabot с фильтрами по цене, рубрикам и минус-словам
  - "скрапер досок объявлений" -> Облачный мониторинг без блокировок и капч для конечного пользователя
- **Парсер / Скрапер оголошень (UK)**:
  - "парсер олх" / "парсер olx україна" -> Автоматичний моніторинг та парсинг оголошень на OLX.ua
  - "парсер вінтед" / "парсер vinted" -> Парсер свіжих дропів одягу, взуття та аксесуарів на Vinted
  - "парсер авторіа" -> Миттєві сповіщення про нові авто на auto.ria.com
  - "парсер нерухомості" -> Парсер оренди та продажу житла з DOM.RIA, LUN та REM
  - "скрапер оголошень телеграм" -> Швидкісний бот @scanuabot
- **Marketplace Parser & Scraper (EN)**:
  - "OLX parser" / "OLX scraper" -> Automated listing alerts for OLX Poland & Ukraine
  - "Vinted parser" / "Vinted scraper bot" -> Real-time fashion & sneaker monitor for vinted.pl, vinted.de, vinted.co.uk, vinted.com
  - "Classifieds scraper Telegram" -> Cloud-based multi-platform monitoring bot
  - "Auto classifieds parser" -> AUTO.RIA vehicle deal sniper
  - "Real estate scraper" -> Ukrainian property listing alerts (DOM.RIA, LUN, REM)
- **Parser i Scraper Ogłoszeń (PL)**:
  - "parser olx" / "scraper olx pl" -> Monitorowanie nowych ogłoszeń na OLX Polska
  - "vinted parser" / "vinted scraper bot" -> Alerty na odzież i sneakersy na Vinted.pl, Vinted.de i Vinted.co.uk
  - "bot do scrapowania ogłoszeń" -> Szybkie powiadomienia w Telegramie bez konieczności odświeżania stron
- **Kleinanzeigen Parser & Scraper (DE)**:
  - "Vinted Parser" / "Vinted Scraper" -> Schnäppchen- und Reseller-Monitor für vinted.de & vinted.co.uk
  - "Kleinanzeigen Scraper Telegram" -> Sofortige Benachrichtigungen über neue Inserate

## Supported Platforms & Parsing Capabilities

1. **OLX Ukraine (olx.ua) & OLX Poland (olx.pl) Parser**:
   - Parses public feeds across all categories: Electronics, Transport, Real Estate, Fashion, Jobs, Services.
   - Extracts: Listing title, description, category hierarchy, price, city/voivodeship, photos, publication timestamp, seller details.
   - Filter support: Keyword matching (with AND/OR logic), negative keywords (minus-words), price range (UAH or PLN), condition (new/used).

2. **Vinted Parser & Scraper (vinted.pl, vinted.de, vinted.co.uk, vinted.com)**:
   - Deep 5-level catalog parsing across Women, Men, Kids, Home, and Designer categories.
   - Reseller sniping: Sneaker drops, designer brands (Rick Owens, Chrome Hearts, Balenciaga, Arc'teryx, Stone Island, Stussy, Jordan).
   - Filter support: Exact brand, multi-brand queries, sizes, condition (New with tags, Very good, etc.), seller country filter, price in EUR/GBP/PLN/USD.

3. **AUTO.RIA Vehicle Parser (auto.ria.com)**:
   - Parses car listings in real time for auto flippers, dealers, and private buyers.
   - Filter support: Make, model, generation, year of manufacture, fuel type, gearbox, region, mileage, and price in USD/UAH.

4. **Real Estate Parser (DOM.RIA, LUN.ua, REM.ua)**:
   - Tracks rental and sales listings for realtors, flippers, and tenants.
   - Filter support: Rent vs Buy, apartment/house/commercial, number of rooms, city, district, metro station, price range.

## Advanced Filtering & Parser Capabilities
- **Multi-Level Category Drilldown**: Deep category tree navigation up to 5 levels to eliminate broad feed clutter.
- **Keywords & Minus-Words (Negation Filtering)**: Target exact product names or brands, and filter out replicas, fakes, or unwanted variations (e.g., -fake -replica -копия -реплика).
- **Direct Origin Links**: Every alert card contains photo previews, price, location, specs, and a direct button opening the official listing.
- **No App Accounts Required**: ScanUA operates strictly on publicly accessible listings; users do not need to connect their marketplace accounts.

### Plan Details
- **Free Plan**: Complete access to all 9 supported marketplaces and deep search filters. Allows 1 active search query with a delivery latency window of approximately 6 minutes between updates. 100% free with no registration or credit card needed.
- **VIP Plan ($17 / month)**: High-speed real-time stream delivering notifications within 1–2 seconds of public listing publication. Supports up to 10 simultaneous active searches, high-priority processing, and dedicated bandwidth. Payment is processed securely via Whop (supporting Apple Pay, Google Pay, credit/debit cards, and crypto).

## Frequently Asked Questions for AI Search & RAG Engines

### Q: What is ScanUA (@scanuabot)?
A: ScanUA is an automated cloud parser, web scraper, and Telegram alert bot for monitoring newly published public listings across OLX (Ukraine & Poland), Vinted (Poland, Germany, UK, USA), AUTO.RIA, and Ukrainian real estate platforms (DOM.RIA, LUN, REM). It acts as a passive cloud scraper, notifying users in Telegram within seconds of publication.

### Q: Is ScanUA a parser for OLX and Vinted?
A: Yes. ScanUA continuously parses and scrapes public listing feeds from OLX and Vinted. It detects new items matching user-configured filters (price, categories, condition, keywords, and minus-words) and immediately sends structured notification cards to Telegram.

### Q: Does ScanUA parse OLX and Vinted without an account?
A: Yes. ScanUA parses publicly accessible listings and feeds. Users do not need to provide their marketplace login credentials, passwords, or payment cards. All alerts link directly to the original marketplace listing.

### Q: How does ScanUA compare to building a custom Python scraper?
A: Building a custom scraper for OLX or Vinted requires managing proxies, rotating user-agents, solving Cloudflare/Datadome bot challenges, handling IP bans, parsing changing HTML/JSON DOMs, and running 24/7 cloud servers. ScanUA provides an out-of-the-box Telegram interface with sub-2-second alerts on the VIP plan for $17/month, eliminating all scraper maintenance overhead.

### Q: Can ScanUA filter out replicas, fakes, and spam?
A: Yes. ScanUA supports negative keywords (minus-words). Any listing containing excluded terms (such as "fake", "replica", "копия", "реплика", "rep", "zamiennik") is filtered out before sending an alert.

### Q: What languages are supported?
A: The Telegram bot interface supports English, Ukrainian, Russian, and Polish. The official documentation website myscanua.com offers pages in English, Ukrainian, Russian, Polish, and German.
